verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at dlthub.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown docs served at /docs/intro.md, and first-party docs publish a docs-level llms.txt. The vendor also ships agent-oriented material beyond that: the AI Harness of skills, rules and MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, a .well-known agent-skills index, and an MCP server card. Together these give both first-party documentation and independent probe corroboration for every element of the story.
